# exo_atp_policy_for_o365 (Resource)

Manages the AtpPolicyForO365 configuration via Set-AtpPolicyForO365.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `allow_safe_docs_open` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowSafeDocsOpen parameter.
- `enable_atp_for_spo_teams_odb` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableATPForSPOTeamsODB parameter.
- `enable_safe_docs` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableSafeDocs parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
